menu.restart_message: Some changes need a restart to apply.
library.no_keys: This Nijiiro installation's Executable/Release/bnusio.dll has no key that opens its files. Put in one that carries them (TaikoArcadeLoader's), then add it again.
library.no_vgmstream: The music needs vgmstream-cli next to the game: get it from github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream/releases.
library.no_official: No Taiko game data or Nijiiro installation there.
settings.language.hint: The game's menus and messages. Applies after a restart.
settings.title_language.hint: Song titles and subtitles in English (when a song has them) or the Japanese originals. Applies after a restart.
settings.show_oni.hint: Song Select shows the Oni course at once. Off: the original, where Oni appears after hitting the right rim repeatedly.
settings.mouse_controls.hint: In the menus the mouse wheel moves as the drum's rims do (songs, player entry, difficulties, settings; replays seek) and a left click is a don. Off: the mouse does nothing there.
settings.gameplay_skin.hint: The theme songs play in. Automatic: each song's own (its chart's SCENEPRESET, the game's song of the same title, Miku for Vocaloid); Original: the regular gameplay; a skin: that one for every song.
settings.fast_song_scroll.hint: Song Select: the list keeps up with quick rim hits, held keys and the mouse wheel; Page Up/Down skip ten songs. Off: the original.
settings.menu_volume.hint: The entry and song select, on top of the master volume. Songs and their results play at the master volume.
settings.attract_volume.hint: The attract loop and its demo plays, on top of the master volume.
settings.calibrate.hint: Sets the Audio Offset: move the notes until each click lands as its note reaches the circle.
settings.audio_offset.hint: + if you hear the music late: notes and judgement move later to meet it. - if you hear it early.
settings.input_offset.hint: + if your hits land late (mostly LATE): they are judged earlier. - if they land early.
settings.drum_debounce.hint: For a drum that sends double hits: every pad ignores a hit this soon after its last one. Rolls are capped too: each pad hits at most 1000 / this times a second, a two-hand roll twice that.
settings.retry_hold.hint: How long the retry key (Q) is held before the song restarts.
settings.record_performance.hint: Writes a performance report (frame times, CPU and memory use) to the logs folder until turned off or the game closes. Send it with a performance problem.
settings.stereo_panning.hint: With two players, each side's sounds come from its own speaker.
settings.mute_in_background.hint: Fade the sound out while the window is in the background.
settings.audio_buffer.hint: Smaller is lower latency; raise it if the sound crackles. Applies after a restart.
settings.exclusive_audio.hint: Windows: the sound device for the game alone, for the lowest latency. Applies after a restart.
settings.fullscreen.hint: F11 switches to a window and back.
settings.fullscreen.hint_exclusive: Exclusive takes the screen at its own resolution: lighter on older PCs. F11 switches to a window and back.
settings.resolution.hint: Also the size upscaled textures load at (screens loaded next). A 4:3 one shows the game letterboxed.
settings.refresh_rate.hint: The screen's refresh rate at this resolution.
settings.vsync.hint: Wait for the screen's refresh: no tearing. Off draws as fast as the PC can (or up to the frame limit).
settings.frame_limit.hint: Frames drawn per second at most (window and borderless): less heat and power.
settings.letterbox_size.hint: Shrink the game inside the screen, as in osu!.
settings.letterbox_x.hint: Where the shrunk game sits: 0% left, 100% right.
settings.letterbox_y.hint: Where the shrunk game sits: 0% top, 100% bottom.
settings.cache_folder.hint: Where decoded songs and upscaled textures are kept. This PC: the user's own cache on whichever PC runs the game, best when the game is on a USB stick. Applies at the next start.
settings.upscaled_textures.hint: Sharper textures, upscaled 3x on this PC and kept in its cache. Applies to screens loaded next.
settings.background_upscaling.hint: CPU threads that upscale textures not in the cache yet while you play (paused during songs).
settings.long_titles.hint: Song titles too long for their column: shrink the text, or squash it at full width like the arcade.
settings.bake.hint: Upscale every texture the game uses now, with most of the CPU. Stop at any time; finished ones are kept.
buttons.search.hint: Song search; the shin-uchi board; practice: held, ←/→ go note to note.
buttons.scores.hint: Scores and replays; practice: after a pass, again or stop.
buttons.restart.hint: Held: restart the song; leaderboard / your plays; practice: the loop's start.
buttons.confirm.hint: Confirm; play / pause a replay or practice.
bake.scanning: Finding the textures to upscale ({0} of {1})
calibration.instructions: Make each click land as its note reaches the circle. ({0})
calibration.controls: Don't drum along. Left rim: notes earlier, right rim: later. Big don (both centres): done.
setup.already_chosen: Already chosen by the other player
setup.wait_for_code: Wait for the other player's code first.
setup.friends_need_account: Friends can join once this PC has an account (Sign in).
setup.no_account: That card has no TaikOnline account.

settings.timing_indicator.hint: A glow under the judgement circle after a hit: blue when early, red when late. Good/Bad: only after a Good or Bad. Always: after Greats too.

online.no_room: That room doesn't exist or is full.
online.failed: Couldn't connect to the other player.
online.name_hint: Leave empty to use your name. Esc cancels.
online.password_hint: Leave empty for no password. Esc cancels.
online.no_course: That course isn't in your copy of the song.
online.waiting_ready: Waiting for the other player to load...
online.lobby_hint: Play a song together with another player.
online.not_sent: The song couldn't be sent: it's too big or can't be read.
online.song_broken: The song that arrived can't be played.
online.share_sent: When the other player doesn't have one of your custom songs, your game sends them its chart and audio.
online.share_authorized: You confirm that you are authorized to share the charts and audio of the songs you play online.
online.share_memory: They stay in the other game's memory only. You're asked this once.
online.no_rooms: No rooms are open right now.
online.warning_direct: Online songs connect your game straight to the other player's.
online.warning_ip: They can see your IP address, even strangers in public rooms and Quick Play.
online.warning_ok: Only continue if you're OK with that.
service.sound_test.note: HIT THE DRUM'S FACE AND RIM TO HEAR THE DRUM.
service.game_mode.hint: HOME: A PC, FREE PLAY AND ENDLESS SONGS. ARCADE: THE CABINET, WITH COINS AND STAGES. CHANGING IT RESTARTS THE GAME.
service.switch.confirm: THE GAME WILL RESTART. SWITCH NOW?
service.test_connection.hint.home: CHECKS THE SERVER NOW (OTHERWISE EVERY 15 SECONDS). THE SERVER IS SET IN CONFIG.CFG.
service.test_connection.hint.arcade: CHECKS THE SERVER AND THE CABINET TOKEN NOW (OTHERWISE EVERY 15 SECONDS). THE SERVER AND TOKEN ARE SET IN CONFIG.CFG.
service.pad.hint: ENTER, THEN PRESS THE INPUT FOR THIS PAD (ESCAPE CANCELS). IT JOINS THE PAD'S OTHERS. BACKSPACE OR DELETE CLEARS IT.
service.set_up_all_pads.hint: ASKS FOR THE FOUR PADS IN TURN, REPLACING THEIR INPUTS ON THIS DEVICE.
service.reset_to_default.hint: THIS PLAYER'S PADS GET THEIR DEFAULT INPUTS ON THIS DEVICE BACK.
service.remove.hint: ENTER REMOVES IT FROM THE LIBRARY.
service.add_official.hint: ANOTHER RELEASE'S GAME DATA OR A NIJIIRO INSTALLATION, JOINED TO THE GAME'S OWN SONGS.
service.rehash.hint: WORKS THE LIBRARY'S CHART HASHES OUT AGAIN (IN THE BACKGROUND).
